articles.title: Australian lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident,' prime minister says - PBS
articles.description: Helen Haines, 65, was struck by a Toyota Land Cruiser SUV outside her electoral district office mid afternoon in the city of Wangaratta in Victoria state, a police said.
